output: You're right that model building takes time to learn, and most non-finance users shouldn't start by designing models. They can begin by entering and reviewing numbers, and the role-based input views are built for that. Onboarding includes admin training, so a trained internal admin, not a consultant, handles routine model changes. For example, [PLACEHOLDER] customer story: operations team updated its own headcount drivers after admin training. Next, I'd like to offer a hands-on session where two of your non-finance budget owners complete a real input task in a sandbox, so you can see how it works for your headteachers before you decide.

messages.content:
<quote>
Our headteachers are not finance people, and I can't see them building or changing a model without someone holding their hand.
</quote>
